description: This file defines a class 'FormatWithGender' that implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. Its purpose is to format an entity value by mapping it to a gender string as defined in the Employee class. It is part of a plugin under the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the maintenance access strategy formatting namespace.

classes.name: FormatWithGender
classes.description: A class that implements value formatting for gender fields based on employee entity data.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the gender string corresponding to the provided entity value, or null if none matches.
